course_position.stage_name: Toward B1 - Complex Conversations and Narratives

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice checking understanding with menar du att.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Clarifying a changed plan, instruction, or small misunderstanding at work.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Keeping a conversation going when information is unclear.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a changed fika or lunch plan and one speaker checks the meaning before acting.

main_focus.name: clarification with menar du att
main_focus.description: Use menar du att to confirm the intended meaning of a statement or plan.
model_examples: Menar du att vi ska träffas efter lunch?
Menar du att kaféet är stängt idag?
main_focus.desired_presence: Use menar du att naturally 2 times, with one follow-up clarification phrase.

useful_chunks: Kan du ta det en gång till?
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use clarification chunks as natural repair strategies in the dialogue.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker gives or repeats a changed plan.
dialogue_shape.middle: The other speaker checks understanding and asks for repetition or clarification.
dialogue_shape.ending: They confirm the correct time, place, or action.

target_complexity.repetition: include enough clarification language for practical learner reuse

focus: what information is unclear at first
what final plan or detail is confirmed

sentence_focus: one sentence with menar du att
one sentence saying the speaker is confused
one sentence combining a changed plan with the final detail
